# Cedarline Retail Buildout

A pre-buildout walkthrough for the Cedarline Retail space was conducted by Larkspur Site Audits on 2026-04-02.[^1] During the walkthrough, Devon Achebe flagged a load-bearing wall near the east entrance as requiring an engineer's sign-off before the framing crew proceeds.[^1]

## Open Questions
- [ ] What is Devon Achebe's role or affiliation? The log did not record this detail.[^1]
- [ ] What is the current status of the required engineer's sign-off on the load-bearing wall?

[^1]: sessions/2026-04-02.md
